worked_solution:
Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{n}\,m & =|\,m\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =12cos\,(\frac{\pi }{4}) \\  & =12\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\  & =6\sqrt{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
